description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single jump attacks capped at 19999, En-Wind Stack or En-Dark Stack, Cap Break Level 1 & Crystal Mode to user
Crystal Mode: Dragoon Ability Boost, Dualcast Dragoon, Zero Hone Cost to Dragoon Abilities & 25% DEF/RES Pierce
Crystal Force I/II: 4 single-target Wind/Dark/NE jump attacks at Cap Break Level 1, Instant Cast, [Cap Break Level 2, Dragoon Damage +50%, Quick ATB & 50% DEF/RES Pierce] for 1 turn to user; After using Crystal Force II, chases with 2 single-target Wind/Dark/NE Overflow jump attacks, Quick/Instant Dragoon 1 & Triple/Quadcast Dragoon 1 to user with at least 0/3 Dragoon/XIV members
